items.title: New GTA 6 character swapping details revealed: Jason and Lucia can 'play as a couple, or go off and cause chaos independently'
items.summary: An interview published in Dazed magazine provides some juicy new details about GTA 6's design and development.

content.v: We've got more Grand Theft Auto 6 details to chew on, and this time not from a vegetable . An interview in magazine Dazed has revealed a bunch of details about the design of GTA 6, including how character swapping between protagonists Jason and Lucia works.
We'll get straight into it. Here are the most notable details from the interview:
1. Exercise and diet
Dazed says that food will affect Jason and Lucia's weight, and "exercising visibly builds and tones their muscles." Playing for long periods without sleeping will also impact their appearance.

Rockstar has played around with these life sims systems in past games—most recently in Red Dead Redemption 2, where Arthur could gain or lose weight based on his diet. GTA hasn't had systems this granular since 2004's GTA: San Andreas, in which CJ could gain weight and lose it through working out.
2. Character swapping

The way GTA 6 handles multiple playable characters will differ from GTA 5. The Dazed preview notes that you can "choose to either play as a couple, or go off and cause chaos independently." They described a scenario where you can cruise along the highway as Jason, then swap to Lucia in the passenger seat to "scroll on the in-game phone."
That sounds, to me, like GTA 6 will have a dynamic 'couple mode' for open world roaming—in keeping with this being a love story—but missions themselves might be solo or together.
3. Rockstar's team size

According to Dazed, Rockstar has massively expanded its team and resources to get all the details in GTA 6 right. The studio has more than doubled in size since Red Dead Redemption 2. It has an office in LA dedicated to the pedestrian NPCs that fill the open world. It also brought in over 50 real world street artists to help design the murals for GTA 6's version of Wynwood, Miami's outdoor art galleries, and there's a team of actual race car drivers handling the vehicle physics.
4. Expect to see a variety of Florida Men
Per Dazed: "Players can expect encounters with virtual iterations of Florida Man, the cultural archetype-turned-meme known IRL for wrangling alligators, drunken antics, and literal grand theft auto."
5. On music
Regarding GTA 6's music, senior vice president of narrative Ruper Humphries told Dazed:

"We love Miami music, particularly Miami bass, going through to more recent Miami artists like Kodak Black and Sexyy Red. We were also really interested in how the hip-hop scene in Miami exists in house parties in Overtown, clubs like Booby Trap on the River, and then high-end places on South Beach where bottles can cost thousands of dollars. We needed characters who could take us through those worlds."
6. Jason and Lucia's backgrounds
The preview notes that Jason is ex-military and a drug runner. Lucia is an amateur fighter (as seen in trailers) fresh out of prison.
7. Choices
Dazed suggests that player choices or behavior will affect Jason and Lucia's relationship in ways that "cut much deeper than Rockstar’s previous titles or 'honour' systems."

items.title: The Frosthaven Board Game Gets a Rare Discount on Amazon

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2023/06/06/frosthaven-blogroll-1686079848469.jpg
Update : This deal is now 100% claimed and no longer available.

Frosthaven is one of the best board games on the market. It served as a follow up to the immensely popular Gloomhaven board game, and is one of the most imposing dungeon-delving board games you can buy. It's also really quite expensive.

It's not often that we see any sort of discount on this game, but Amazon currently has a Lightning Deal running that drops it down to its lowest price ever. For a limited time (or while stock lasts), you can pick up this massive board game for $153. The discount is set to expire around 7:45pm PT or when the deal is fully claimed.

Frosthaven comes as an enormous box full of stuff. There's an incredibly thick rulebook, decks of cards, trays, dividers, a map, and miniatures. All-in-all, there are a few hundred hours worth of gameplay that comes packaged in a rather large box. And if you already own Gloomhaven characters and items, you can use them in this game as well. It's a massive campaign game that can be pretty daunting for casual players.
What We Said in Our Review
We gave Frosthaven a 9 out of 10 in our review , with the caveat that you may want to jump into Jaws of the Lion first if you're a newcomer. Here's what we had to say about the game:

"Weirdly, although Frosthaven improves on its predecessor in almost every respect, it’s far harder to recommend. Its sheer weight and the glory of the game that came before it holds it back. If you’re a Gloomhaven fan but you haven’t yet finished working your way through that behemoth of a box it’s better to stick with what you know for now rather than start a new project. If you’re new to the entire franchise then you should absolutely jump into that brilliant combat and exploration engine but the cut-down Jaws of the Lion is a better introduction. If you’re one of the rare few who not only have seen everything Gloomhaven has to offer but also remain hungry for more, however, Frosthaven is the banquet to satiate you. Bigger, bolder and better than the original, if you can find time for it in your life it’s an epic gaming experience like no other." - Matt Thrower

With a bachelor's degree in communication and 10 years of professional writing experience, his expertise is spread across a variety of different pop culture topics -- from TV series to books and the latest LEGO sets .

items.title: The Expanse’s Most Iconic Foe Shows Up In Osiris Reborn’s New Trailer
items.summary: Owlcat Games has given players a new look at its upcoming sci-fi RPG based on The Expanse. The latest trailer

content.v: Owlcat Games has given players a new look at its upcoming sci-fi RPG based on The Expanse. The latest trailer for The Expanse: Osiris Reborn aired during Gamescom 's Find Your Next Game showcase, giving players a better look at Owlcat's take on one of the TV show's most frightening foes: Project Caliban .

In The Expanse TV show (and the books upon which it is based), Project Caliban is a top-secret experiment run by a company called Protogen, which hopes to harness the recently discovered Protomolecule to create supersoldiers. Unsurprisingly, the results are tragic—and terrifying. Based on the trailer, Osiris Reborn players will be facing off with both Protogen's hired guns and one of Project Caliban's many unfortunate human test subjects, who has taken the form of a human-Protomolecule hybrid, just like the one shown in Season 2 of The Expanse TV show.

When it comes to the Protomolecule's appearance, it seems that Owlcat is taking inspiration from the television show rather than the book series--in the show, the Protomolecule is a bright, glowing blue; in the books it's described as a slimy, brownish substance rather than the bioluminescent blue seen in the latest Osiris Reborn trailer.

The new trailer also provides a better look at a female version of the player-character (simply called "the Captain" in-game) as she explores the Protogen facility on Ganymede. Osiris Reborn players can also choose to play as a male character, but after complaints about the original male player-character's voice acting surfaced in the wake of the game's April 2026 beta test, Owlcat Games has recast the role of the male lead (which is likely why we don't hear a word from him in this trailer).

The Expanse: Osiris Reborn does not yet have a specific release date, but is expected to launch for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S sometime in Q2 2027. It is currently available to wishlist on Steam .

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Will Have RPG Mechanics Like Eating, Exercising, and More
items.summary: Some of the first gameplay details for Grand Theft Auto 6 have been confirmed, and it seems like Rockstar is e

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/26/gta-6-raul-1787763525044.jpg
Some of the first gameplay details for Grand Theft Auto 6 have been confirmed, and it seems like Rockstar is embracing a more RPG-type style this time around.

As part of a cover story for Dazed magazine , Rockstar Games revealed heaps of new information about Grand Theft Auto 6. Arguably the most notable details revolve around some of its gameplay features. In GTA 6, players will be able to eat, work out, and sleep, all of which have an impact on the game's two protagonists, Jason and Lucia. Players will have to take care of the Bonnie and Clyde-esque couple, as eating will affect their weight, working out will visibly change their build and strength, and a lack of sleep will negatively impact their features. It's unclear if a lack of sleep will impact the actual gameplay, or if they'll just look sleep-deprived, but it's a clear sign of Rockstar's attention to detail.

For many, this may remind them of Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. That game featured a lot of RPG mechanics that allowed CJ to fluctuate in weight and fitness. Later games largely dropped these elements, but GTA 5 featured a stat system that allowed players to enhance their stamina and strength by doing physical activities such as running, playing sports, and riding bikes.

Additionally, there is also a social media feed for players to scroll, something fans have speculated about since the game's reveal in 2023. Character switching is also returning from GTA 5, allowing players to play as a couple or split up and operate independently. Dazed teased that the relationship between these two is a major focus of the game and that choices made by the player have "repercussions that cut much deeper" than the honor system in the Red Dead Redemption series.

“We look back at our previous games with a critical eye and see where we want to evolve based on what we didn’t do as well as we would have liked to, either because we didn’t have the time, resources or technological capabilities, or in some cases things we just didn’t do as well or consider as fully as we could have,” said Rob Nelson, co-studio head at Rockstar North. “A lot of what we do is very iterative — we adjust a lot of things by feel based on what is working and what isn’t.”

Based on that information, it's possible that there will be some kind of relationship meter that can impact how Jason and Lucia feel about each other. Ultimately, it sounds like Rockstar is making a much more nuanced and interactive game. That should hardly come as a surprise following Red Dead Redemption 2, but it seems like Rockstar is really pushing the envelope with GTA 6. Tomorrow, fans will get a proper look at the game thanks to an extended look releasing on Netflix at 3 PM ET , with a YouTube version to follow six hours later.

GTA 6 has suffered from a plethora of leaks over the last week, including a story-focused one earlier today . Rockstar Games released a statement this morning confirming that the situation was "heartbreaking," but it is working hard to deliver a product that exceeds expectations.
Grand Theft Auto 6 will release on November 19th for Xbox Series X|S and PS5.
Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

items.title: Tim Curry Has Died, Leaving Behind Some Unforgettable Video Game Performances
items.summary: Legendary actor Tim Curry has died, aged 80. The star of the Rocky Horror Picture Show, the English actor was

content.v: Legendary actor Tim Curry has died, aged 80. The star of the Rocky Horror Picture Show, the English actor was also celebrated for his work in the recording booth, bringing dozens of animated series and video game characters to life-- including a scene-stealing performance as Premier Anatoly Cherdenko in Command & Conquer: Red Alert 3.

While a cause of death hasn't been revealed, it is worth noting that Curry had been battling various health issues after he had a major stroke in 2012. The English actor dealt with short-term memory and mobility issues following this, although he continued to work in the entertainment industry.

Film roles like Darkness in Legend, the concierge in Home Alone 2: Lost in New York, Pennywise in Stephen King's It, and Long John Silver in Muppet Treasure Island cemented his role as a Hollywood legend, and he was also a regular on several TV series throughout the decades. Curry regularly appeared on stage--including a memorable performance as King Arthur in Spamalot--and he even released several albums.
For many fans, Curry will be forever immortalized for his plans to escape to the one place uncorrupted by capitalism: SPACE!

Curry's death is sadly the latest in the entertainment industry, as country singer Dolly Parton also passed away this week, and last week, Nashville star Hayden Panettiere's death sent shockwaves when it was announced.

items.title: I added a gang notoriety system to GTA 5, but it mostly seems to make them murder everyone except me
items.summary: Which, you know, is positive I guess.

content.v: It's kind of strange that the state monopoly on violence is the only gang you can start an even slightly lasting beef with in Grand Theft Auto 5. Real-life gangs aren't known for their live-and-let-live attitude, and yet if you stroll around town shooting Ballas and Cartel members, they will adopt a stance of Christ-like forgiveness the second you're out of eyesight. The cops at least will spend a little time hunting you before they give up.

This is what I aimed to fix when I installed Gang Notoriety into my tottering Jenga tower of GTA 5 mods. The pitch is simple: gangs will get sustainably angry with you now, accruing wanted stars much like the cops do until you manage to lose the heat.
To test this new facet of GTA 5's rich simulation, I teleported (I can teleport now) to Grove Street and began shooting.

It sort of worked? The minimap blossomed with a thousand red and orange rings—each denoting a gang member who was very cross with me and ready to do something about it. I got a wanted star, too. Whether that was the gang's wanted star or just regular cops being upset about me shooting people in the street? Hard to say.

But things quickly got weird. Before too long, the assembled Ballas of Grove Street started to lose interest in me and started to gain interest in… each other? They ducked behind cover and started attacking each other, and at some point one loosed a rottweiler, which just seemed rather confused by the entire situation. Meanwhile, the frictionless vehicles of Los Santos continued to wheel all about us, including in the sky.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/TEg7PusxN4bENho7hEDX8C.gif

Though my minimap was still red, everyone had lost interest in me. The Ballas seemed to have become notorious among the Ballas. They all eventually took care of themselves, save the sole survivor, who had quite the wanted level himself, thanks to a previous mod.
I will get back to you when I figure out the moral of this story.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kkNtsnEsZiTdgmuFTn4pJ6.jpg

items.title: 《GTA6》外媒专访 男女主随意切换 体重系统惊人
items.summary: 外媒Dazed发布了与Rockstar Games的独家专访，并公开了7张全新《GTA6》游戏截图与一张杂志封面。

content.v: 外媒Dazed发布了与Rockstar Games的独家专访，并公开了7张全新《GTA6》游戏截图与一张杂志封面。
采访中，Rockstar叙事高级副总裁Rupert Humphries及开发团队透露了大量关于《GTA6》的核心细节，涵盖游戏开发历程、世界交互、角色系统与叙事方向。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270041062419.jpg
开发周期：自2013年起，团队规模已翻倍
据Rockstar透露，《GTA6》的开发工作大致始于 2013年。自《荒野大镖客2》发售后，开发团队规模已扩大一倍以上，目前在全球设有多个工作室，其中洛杉矶分部几乎专注于NPC（非玩家角色）行为系统的开发。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270042018649.jpg
世界交互：持枪上街会引起城市反应，NPC更智能
游戏世界将更加真实：玩家持步枪走在街上，城市中的NPC会对此做出反应。Rockstar表示，NPC的行为“越来越不像传统NPC”，世界对玩家选择的反应比以往任何作品都更贴近现实。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270042066033.jpg
角色切换：可随时在Jason与Lucia之间无缝切换
玩家既可以选择作为一对情侣共同行动，也可以独立行事。在驾驶过程中，玩家可操控Jason驾车，也可随时切换至坐在副驾驶的Lucia，使用游戏内手机浏览社交动态。当任务演变为追车战时，无缝切换系统允许玩家瞬间从驾驶位切换到副驾驶窗口开火。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270042122739.jpg
叙事主线：邦妮与克莱德式故事，选择后果更深远
Humphries明确表示，《GTA6》的叙事被有意识地设定为“邦妮与克莱德式”的爱情与犯罪故事。玩家的选择将带来比Rockstar以往作品更为深远的影响，远超传统的“荣誉值”系统。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270042186724.png
角色系统：饮食影响体重，锻炼改变体型
Jason与Lucia的饮食会影响体重，而锻炼则能明显塑造肌肉线条。若长时间远离床铺、在逃亡或连续活动中，身体状态也会相应变化。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270042253918.png
世界细节：佛罗里达男人、真实品牌与街头艺术家
玩家将在游戏中遇到“佛罗里达男人”的虚拟版本——这一现实中的网络迷因形象以短吻鳄、醉酒恶作剧和真实“侠盗猎车”著称。游戏中的品牌、商店与广告将“与现实高度相似”，每个品牌都被塑造成莱昂尼达文化生态中有实际功能的实体。为设计罪恶城等区域的壁画，Rockstar邀请了 超过50位现实街头艺术家 参与创作。而负责车辆操控的团队成员，本身就是真正的赛车手。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270042333626.png
《GTA6》将于2026年11月发售，登陆PS5与Xbox Series X|S平台。本次专访揭示了Rockstar在构建“完全沉浸式世界”方面的野心——从NPC智能到角色身体系统，从品牌生态到街头细节，每一处都在向更真实的虚拟世界迈进。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270042442668.png

items.title: 《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》M站开分 PS5版79分
items.summary: 《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》的媒体评价已经正式解禁，目前本作PS5版评分79分，Xbox版评分88分。PC版评分84分。

content.v: 《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》的媒体评价已经正式解禁，目前本作PS5版评分79分，Xbox版评分88分。PC版评分84分。
其中PS5版收录34家媒体，Xbox版收录4家媒体，PC版收录29家媒体。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270032598695.png
Digital Chumps 95分：
《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》展现了Asobo Studio在情感叙事上的深厚热情与专业水准，故事充满张力与冒险。当一切真相浮出水面，玩家伴随索菲亚走过这段艰辛旅程后，她并非毫发无伤地全身而退，但她却成为记忆中最真实、最具情感冲击力的主角之一。这部充满不断惊喜、壮丽景色与动人情感的作品，是一件真正的艺术品，一场令人难忘的冒险。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270033051209.jpg
ComicBook 90分：
在惊艳的画面、跨越数个世纪的情感共鸣叙事以及丰富多样的玩法循环之间，《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》从头到尾都给我留下了深刻印象。在我游玩过程中，游戏运行流畅，基本没有遇到技术问题，我玩得非常开心。这是一个我会长久回味的故事和游戏体验，这本身就很有分量。无论你是《瘟疫传说》系列的老玩家还是新玩家，如果你喜欢一款以强大叙事为核心的优秀动作冒险游戏，那么《共鸣》绝对值得一试。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270033091406.jpg
Game Informer 85分：
《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》成功运用了熟悉的类型元素，并讲述了一个动人的故事，主角是一位魅力十足的海盗，她正经历着人生中可能最具冲击力也最悲惨的冒险。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270033147964.jpg
Push Square 70分：
《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》将系列引向了更侧重战斗的方向，而且这一尝试大体上是成功的。这是一部电影化风格强烈的作品，将剑斗、解谜与跑酷融为一体，外观和手感上依然保留了浓厚的《瘟疫传说》风味。然而，非常缓慢的开局和糟糕的帧率问题影响了这部第三部作品，不过《共鸣》最终还是呈现出了一部扎实的续作。

items.title: 苹果发布会定档9月10日！全新一代iPhone要来了
items.summary: IT之家 8 月 27 日消息，苹果官方宣布将于当地时间 9 月 9 日（北京时间 9 月 10 日凌晨 1 点）举行秋季新品发布会，主题为“惊喜闪…

content.v: IT之家 8 月 27 日消息，苹果官方宣布将于当地时间 9 月 9 日（北京时间 9 月 10 日凌晨 1 点）举行秋季新品发布会，主题为“惊喜闪耀”（Surprise and shine）。
这将是约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）于 9 月 1 日正式接任苹果 CEO 后的首场发布会，预计将推出全新一代 iPhone 18 Pro / Max 以及 Ultra 系列折叠屏新机。后续，苹果还将于明年春季推出 iPhone 18 基础版及 iPhone 18e 等新品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270026494417.png
结合此前爆料，iPhone 18 Pro 系列预计为常规升级，主要亮点包括：
首发 2nm 工艺的 A20 Pro 芯片，能效与性能提升；
后置主摄有望升级可变光圈镜头；
采用苹果自研 C2 蜂窝调制解调器；
灵动岛打孔面积可能缩小。
受内存芯片持续短缺影响，售价可能较前代大幅上涨。
很显然，本次发布会的绝对主角将是苹果首款折叠屏 iPhone。据多方爆料，该设备采用横向书本式折叠设计，闭合状态下外屏约 5.5 英寸，展开后内屏约 7.6 英寸，展开后类似 iPad。
其机身采用钛合金框架与超薄设计，屏幕折痕控制出色。因机身厚度限制，该设备可能放弃 Face ID，转而采用集成于电源键的 Touch ID，且后置可能仅配备双摄、无长焦镜头。该设备起售价预计在 1,999 美元至 2,500 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 13,467 元至 16,843 元人民币）之间。
Apple Watch 方面，苹果届时有望推出新一代 Apple Watch Series 12 与 Apple Watch Ultra 4，但多为处理器升级与健康传感器更新，外观设计无重大变化。
智能家居方面，苹果有一定可能推出新一代 Apple TV 4K、新版 HomePod mini，以及传闻已久的智能家居控制中枢（Home Hub）—— 一款配备 7 英寸屏幕、支持 FaceTime 的智能家居控制设备。此外，第八代 iPad mini 有望亮相，或将升级为 OLED 显示屏。
软件方面，苹果将在发布会上公布 iOS 27、iPadOS 27、macOS Golden Gate 等系统更新的正式推送日期。发布会仍将以录播形式进行，苹果官网、YouTube 及 Apple TV 将提供直播。

items.title: God help us, they overclocked Mega Man
items.summary: That's going to void a warranty for sure.

content.v: Even if Mega Man's been out of Capcom's spotlight for a few years now, there's still been something refreshingly reliable about his presence. Sure, he might get a leaf shield or a throwing saw sometimes depending on which of his machine-kin he's forced to cull, but by and large, his capabilities are easy to wrap your hand around: He has an arm cannon, and you can charge it. It's predictable. It's safe. It's comfortable.
So what the hell is that?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GAb8M8hQT4it8VYKvmGbCb.png

During last night's Gamescom Opening Night Live, Capcom released its first glimpse of gameplay for Mega Man: Dual Override, the first entry in the classic Mega Man lineup since 2018. And it's with the appropriate gravity that I'm forced to report: They've gone and overclocked Mega Man.

According to Capcom, Dual Override has Mega Man "overriding his limits and powering up for a new adventure" by using "new Custom Chips to freely modify and enhance your abilities" and an Override system that can "unleash overwhelming power for a limited time." In other words, someone thought it would be a good idea to crank up the voltage on our sweet android son beyond the recommended manufacturer guidelines.

The results, I'll admit, seem pretty effective: In the gameplay trailer embedded above, Mega Man's aftermarket mods can let him shoot a barrage of damaging projectiles, hover over platforming hazards, and dash around enemies for a more advantageous shooting position.

I can't help but notice, however, that after deploying those modifications, he's forced to expose his visibly incandescent heatsinks to avoid overheating. There's even a moment late in the footage where he pulls a Unicorn Gundam and enters Destroy Mode, exposing all his available cooling surfaces to fire a massively overcharged shot that—to his credit—insta-KOs a boss. But it also leaves him sparking and billowing smoke.
This just seems irresponsible during a hardware shortage crisis, is all I'm saying.
We don't have a precise release date for Mega Man: Dual Override yet, but it's set to launch sometime in 2027. You can wishlist it on Steam now.

items.title: IGN 6分！《瘟疫传说》新作评价出炉：战斗重复乏味
items.summary: 《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》是一款带有解谜类型的动作冒险游戏，由Asobo Studio制作、Focus Entertainment发行。将于8月28日正式发售，…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270015429811.jpg
《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》是一款带有解谜类型的动作冒险游戏，由Asobo Studio制作、Focus Entertainment发行。将于8月28日正式发售，登陆PC/PS5/XSX平台。
今日，《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》评分正式出炉，IGN为本作打出了6分的评价，一起来看看评价内容吧。
短评： 《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》是一部前传衍生作品，它在该系列的基础上做了大量颇具新意的尝试，但其中只有一部分创新取得了不错的效果。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270015502037.jpg
IGN评分：6分
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270015588124.png
总评： 《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》是该系列的一部前传衍生作品。本作进行了大量大胆新颖的革新：启用全新主角，将战斗重心转向近身肉搏，甚至带来了一套全新的机制。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270016082479.jpg
部分创新确实收获了不错的效果，例如你后期将要面对的全新敌人，还有围绕古老文明遗迹展开的主线故事。但更多试验性设计却收效甚微。主角自身的人物旅程感染力大打折扣；战斗部分很快就陷入重复乏味；控光解谜也仅仅只能带来零星浅薄的乐趣，远达不到惊艳的水准。
索菲亚的起源故事依旧存有不少可圈可点之处，如果你只是渴望再度徜徉在这个压抑却又暗藏希望的世界观中，会获得一定乐趣。但本作始终没能像阿米西亚与雨果的两段冒险那样，给我带来足够震撼的体验。

content.v: We have Star Wars: Galactic Racer at home.

Our prayers for a Star Wars: Galactic Racer Switch 2 announcement still haven't been answered, so our minds have naturally started to drift to other Podracing alternatives on the system. We recalled a crafty little Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom build from a few years back that rather brilliantly brought the Boonta Eve Classic to Hyrule, and what do you know, in the two years since, the designer has refined the build for even more film accuracy.

There has been no rest for @domodesu0002 , it seems. The new Ultrahand build makes the first design look like a proof of concept, now complete with realistic-looking engine covers, rockets, a more Anakin-esque cable system, and a chassis that looks straight out of Tattooine.

content.v: Have you ever looked at your cat and thought, 'I bet they'd love Metal Gear Solid'. Well, if you have, then not only does your cat have impeccable taste, but you can share in the hobby with these new MGS-themed cat toys. Just not at Gamescom.

No, unfortunately, for everyone wandering through the Koelnmesse right now, Konami is bringing its set of MGS cat gear to CatCon 2026 instead, the "world's largest cat-centric pop-up event—ok, I guess that makes more sense than Cologne. Fans will be able to pick up plushie pet toys, cat collars inspired by Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker and Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots , and scratch boxes both online and at the booth from October 10-11.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/E6ts437fFJ2QR5PfabrWqD.png

But those who make it to the booth will also get the added benefit of meeting Uno the one-eared cat, who Konami aptly names a 'cat-fluencer'. I'm not the biggest fan of influencers, but I'll make an exception for Uno because she looks very polite. "Uno and Kat featured in a special playthrough video of Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 where they revealed the specialty cardboard cat boxes."

I don't even have a cat and I want to get one of these—they actually look surprisingly good for videogame merch. So I guess the next logical step is to get a cat and then find one of those scratch boxes. But for now I guess I'll just add it to my cat-centric video game items, somewhere between the cat-themed PC case and the fluffy cat keyboard .

This is just one way in which Konami plans to celebrate the release of Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2, which comes out tomorrow August 27. But honestly, I think I'm more excited for the cat scratch boxes now.

items.title: 6 indie.io Games Coming to gamescom and PAX West That Have Free Demos on Steam

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/monster-park-tycoon-key-art-1787604509317.png

Publishing platform indie.io will be on hand at gamescom and PAX West in the coming weeks, and it’s bringing six games for people to try out in person. But if you’re not one of the lucky people who can be there yourself, don’t worry: all six games have free demos you can play on Steam right now, no badge or ticket required.

As tends to be the case with indie.io, their selection of games covers a wide range of genres. There’s everything from a cozy vineyard château builder to a brutal turn-based roguelite RPG. There’s a little something for all kinds of gamers, and you can try out all of them right now.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/monster-park-tycoon-key-art-1787602371901.png
Monster Park Tycoon

If you watched IGN’s recent Indie Loop showcase, you would have seen this game under another name. Formerly called Monster Zoo Tycoon, it unveiled its new name on August 10, but the dev team and core gameplay remain the same. In Monster Park Tycoon from developer OverPowered Team, you build and manage a monster park where visitors can come see a variety of strange and terrifying abominations. But there’s a twist: your park is a front for a cult. Not a very smart cult, at that.

In order to expand your park, you’ll need to trick and capture your guests using traps disguised as park props. Once you’ve got them, you can either feed them to your monsters, brainwash them to turn them into cultists, or sacrifice them to gain Faith and unlock favors from your Dark Lord.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/monster-park-tycoon-screenshot-1787602371901.jpg

Different monsters require different diets (like brains, blood, or souls), conditions for their exhibits, and behaviors that can become an issue if you ignore them. As your number of monsters grows, it’s inevitable that some of them will break free of their confinement, which is when all hell breaks loose. So you’ll have to control the chaos as you try to grow both your park and your cult in this darkly funny management sim.
Monster Park Tycoon has a brand-new demo available on Steam that marks the first time anyone outside the dev team has been able to play it.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/dunebound-tactics-key-art-1787602371900.png
Dunebound Tactics

In this roguelite, you’ll engage in tactical turn-based combat as you try to lead a band of survivors across a perilous desert in search of a new home. Your ship is fragile and your access to an all-important resource called Elios is limited. As you travel across the dunes, you’ll gather Elios from quests, from the bodies of defeated enemies, or if things get truly desperate, from sacrificing your crew members.

This is a roguelite, so you’re expected to fail. A lot. But each run builds on the ones before it. Each time a caravan is destroyed, you’ll start again with a new one. But you can find the wreck of the previous caravan, which can reward you with modules to empower your crew or even survivors who were part of your previous run.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/dunebound-tactics-screenshot-1787602371900.png

Your crew has a roster of 15 classes with 16 unique traits that determine their skills, stats, and abilities. Combat takes place on a grid, where cover is available but the terrain is fully destructible. So you can mold that terrain to your advantage and use it to outwit your enemies.

Dunebound Tactics was featured during Steam Next Fest, and afterward its demo was rebuilt based on player feedback. In developer Terahard Ltd.’s own words, “If you haven’t played the demo recently, it’s not the demo you remember.” You can play the new and improved demo on Steam .
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/we-took-that-trip-key-art-1787602371901.png
We Took That Trip

Quite a tonal departure from the first two entries on this list, We Took That Trip from developer Lucito Loquito is a calm and relaxing road trip game. There are no timers or deadlines, no great quest that needs to be completed. It’s just you and your cat traveling in a van and meeting new people.

There are three game modes to choose from: Story, Zen, and Background. Story Mode tells a heartwarming tale of friendship, loss, and reunion. Zen is just about the vibe, going for a ride with no real goal in mind. And Background is an AFK mode that takes care of the driving for you, so you can just enjoy the visuals and lo-fi soundtrack.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/we-took-that-trip-screenshot-1787602371901.png

Each trip is procedurally generated and lasts as long as you choose, so every trip is different. There are points of interest scattered across your route, like gas stations, stores, and lookout towers, where you’ll meet people and hear their stories. But the focus is always the road and your Microbus, which you customize both the interior and exterior of with paint, stickers, and other decorations.
If you’re looking for a peaceful way to de-stress after a long day, you can check out the demo on Steam .
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/cozy-builder-key-art-1787602371900.png
Cozy Builder

The peaceful vibes continue with the aptly named Cozy Builder, a sandbox building sim from Pangea Game Studios where you’ll start from scratch and restore Vineyard Valley to its former glory. You’ll use modular architectural pieces to create your château and harvest grapes, herbs, and wildflowers to create your own wines and other goods to share with the townsfolk or sell to continue funding your château.

There are tons of customization options for your château, including a variety of artwork and furniture for the interior and gardens, terraces, and greenhouses for the exterior. You can connect the greenhouse to your home, giving you a place to nurture flowers and collect rare plants.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/cozy-builder-screenshot-1787602371900.jpg

You can do all of this solo or build a shared space with your friends in multiplayer, giving each of you the chance to show off your creativity. The demo has been getting updated throughout the summer to add new features, like one-click item moving in destruct mode and full key rebinding. You can try it out for yourself on Steam .
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/mayday-the-survival-island-key-art-1787602371901.png
Mayday: The Survival Island

This open-world survival crafting game from developer Pequi Studios sees you wake up alone on an island after a mysterious crash. You’re injured, disoriented, and surrounded by untamed wilderness, so you’ll have to find a way to sustain yourself and survive. To do that, you’ll need to gather resources, craft tools, hunt wild animals, catch fish, grow crops, and build a homestead that can sustain you while you try to figure out what happened to you.

As it turns out, the island you washed up on is one of 24 that make up an archipelago, and your adventure will take you to all of them, each of which has different environments, resources, and hidden treasures. So you’ll need to continuously upgrade your tools and figure out how to adapt to each island’s challenges.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/mayday-the-survival-island-screenshot-1787602371901.jpg

There aren’t any timed objectives or linear paths, so you decide the pace at which the story unfolds. If you want to spend hours building up your base, raising animals, and tending crops, you can do that. Or you can just find what you need to keep surviving and move on to the next part of the story, it’s up to you.

That story of Mayday: The Survival Island is focused on the mysteries of the island and how you ended up there. You’ll find strange symbols, magical totems, and fragments of a lost civilization that hint these islands are more than meets the eye. And the more you explore, the more you’ll question if ending up here was an accident and if escape is even possible. You can get a taste of all this with the free Steam demo .
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/esports-manager-2026-key-art-1787602371901.png
